segments.source: "Once on a time there was a little boy who was out walking on the road, and when he had walked a bit he found a box.
"'I am sure there must be something pretty in this box,' he said to himself; but however much he turned it, and however much he twisted it, he was not able to get it open.
"But when he had walked a bit farther, he found a little tiny key.
Then he got tired and sat down, and all at once he thought what fun it would be if the key fitted the box, for it had a little key-hole in it.
So he took the little key out of his pocket, and then he blew first into the pipe of the key, and afterwards into the key-hole, and then he put the key into the key-hole and turned it.
'Snap' it went within the lock; and when he tried the hasp, the box was open.
"But can you guess what there was in the box?
Why a cow's tail; and if the cow's tail had been longer, this story would have been longer too."
